hero.title: The People Behind Every Classroom
hero.dis: Meet the educators, leaders, and mentors working every day to ensure every child thrives.

team.heading: Passionate Minds, Dedicated Hearts
team.intro: Our team brings together grassroots educators, curriculum designers, child-welfare specialists, and community leaders committed to educational equity.

members.name: Priya Nair
members.bio: Former public school educator with 18+ years of experience building community-led learning centers across rural and urban districts.

members.name: Samuel Mensah
members.bio: Specializes in foundational literacy, bilingual curriculum design, and scalable after-school mentorship models.

members.name: Elena Duarte
members.bio: Leads our Educator Fellowship, training over 120 local women and youth in child-centered, play-based pedagogy.

members.name: Amir Hassan
members.bio: Works closely with village councils, parent committees, and public schools to ensure every learning center is community-owned.

members.name: Dr. Kavita Rao
members.bio: Champions adolescent girls' scholarships, health awareness, and secondary school continuation across 25+ communities.

members.name: David Chen
members.bio: Designs solar-powered computer labs and portable hands-on science kits for rural classrooms.

members.name: Meera Krishnan
members.bio: Coordinates 80+ weekend volunteers, reading buddies, and corporate supply-packing drives.

members.name: Arjun Mehta
members.bio: Ensures 100% financial transparency, donor reporting, and quarterly student learning assessments.

joinCta.title: Share Your Time, Transform a Classroom
joinCta.description: We are always looking for passionate weekend mentors, storytellers, digital trainers, and field coordinators to join our growing movement.
